facts.summary: Phase 2 primary eGFR endpoint missed statistical significance; higher rejection vs tacrolimus · Phase 2 · tegoprubart in kidney transplant rejection prevention · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Although the primary endpoint did not reach statistical significance, tegoprubart maintained strong renal function, delivering what the Company believes is the highest mean eGFR level reported to date
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Although the primary endpoint did not reach statistical significance, tegoprubart maintained strong renal function
evidence.safety: Tegoprubart demonstrated a favorable safety and tolerability profile, substantially reducing the metabolic, neurologic, and cardiovascular toxicities commonly associated with tacrolimus
evidence.program_discontinued: Based on these results, Eledon plans to advance tegoprubart into Phase 3 development following discussions with regulators on study design and data requirements.
